C1283.title: Mass-Scale Theft of Online Short-Form Content Using Technical Means
C1283.summary: In April 2026, courts in Jiaxing, Zhejiang disclosed the province’s first criminal case involving copyright infringement of online short-form fiction. Public material states that the actor used technical means to download and collect short-form works from multiple platforms without authorization and built a piracy site to distribute them for profit. The number of works and illegal gains were substantial, and the actor was ultimately held criminally liable for copyright infringement. Compared with manual copying, bulk scraping and automated site building greatly expand the distribution scale of infringing works and lower the cost of piracy access, raising requirements for copyright protection, crawler detection, and evidence preservation.

references.title: Zhejiang's First Online Short-Form Content Copyright Infringement Case Is Heard and Decided
